blocks.text: Singapore and China can work together to strengthen development in South-east Asia, Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said on Friday (Sep 25), with digitalisation and the green economy identified as key areas for bilateral cooperation. “Singapore and China have spent decades building trust through mutually beneficial cooperation. We should now draw on that trust to build capabilities in Singapore and across Asean,” said DPM Gan, who is also minister for trade and industry (trade). He also doubled down on ongoing avenues for collaboration between Singapore and China, which is one of the city-state’s largest trading partners. Connectivity and openness “have […]...
